_comment: VERIFIED CASE LAW REPOSITORY INDEX: Contains authentic citations, case titles, courts, years, and file paths to full-text judgments supplied in the repository. Do not invent citations.

cases.case_name: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar & Anr.
cases.key_principles: Guidelines on arrest under Section 498A IPC and Section 41 CrPC; mandatory notice of appearance.

cases.case_name: D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal
cases.key_principles: Custodial violence and mandatory guidelines to be followed by police during arrest and detention.

cases.case_name: Kesavananda Bharati Sripadagalvaru & Ors. v. State of Kerala & Anr.
cases.key_principles: Basic Structure Doctrine; Parliament cannot alter the basic structure of the Constitution under Article 368.

cases.case_name: Lalita Kumari v. Govt. of U.P. & Ors.
cases.key_principles: Mandatory registration of FIR under Section 154 CrPC if cognizable offence is disclosed.

cases.case_name: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India
cases.key_principles: Interlinking of Articles 14, 19, and 21; procedure established by law must be just, fair, and reasonable.
